question: What programmes and initiatives did Akbank run in 2024 in the area of gender equality and inclusion?

expected.answer: In 2024 Akbank ran several programmes on women's employment, representation and mentoring, and on supporting working parents and employees with disabilities.

key_points: Through the İkinci Bahar (Second Spring) Project, 38 women who had taken a career break were hired
Male employees were included in the 3rd term of the Rol Model Akbanklı (Role Model Akbanker) Programme; 20 participants completed the mentoring, and the 4th term started with 20 new participants
Akbank became a founding supporter of the Milyon Kadına Mentor (Mentor to a Million Women) Programme; nearly 86 volunteer Akbank mentors take part
Through the Yeniden Başlasın (Fresh Start) programme, women employees returning from maternity leave received mentoring support; leave practices for parents were continued
In the Engelsiz Akbank (Barrier-free Akbank) programme, employees with disabilities were surveyed, and the improvement suggestions are planned to be implemented in 2025

question: What practices did Akbank introduce in 2024 in employee experience and employee development, and what results did it achieve in this area?

expected.answer: In 2024 Akbank extended paternity leave to 20 working days; introduced new leave rights such as study leave, end-of-marriage leave and paid caregiver leave, and launched an Emergency Application. It hired 1,890 new employees, 12,628 employees benefited from training and 1,497 people attended the Leadership Meetings.

key_points: Paternity leave was extended to 20 working days
7 working days of study leave, 3 days of end-of-marriage leave and up to 3 months of paid caregiver leave were introduced
